package_path.gdscript: Java package names map to res://src/mindustry/<package_path>/ folders.

imports.gdscript: Imports are recorded in manifests; Godot class_name resolution replaces direct import statements.

class.gdscript: Java class declarations emit GDScript files with class_name and optional extends.

enum.gdscript: Java enum declarations emit constants and lookup dictionaries.

field.gdscript: Instance fields emit var declarations; static final primitives emit const when possible.
field.example: public int hardness -> var hardness: int

method.gdscript: Java methods emit func declarations with normalized names and manifest parameter metadata.

constructor.gdscript: Constructors emit _init with matching parameter metadata.

static_initializer.gdscript: Static initializer blocks emit registry bootstrap functions run in deterministic order.

overload.gdscript: Overloaded methods emit suffixed implementations plus optional dispatcher methods.
